cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then present it to the buyer yourself. I'll print your name in the programme; everyone will know whose medal was worth giving up.

mechanism: A imitates confident valuation language without understanding it to persuade B to give up a treasured medal.
confusable: S04 borrows expertise; S03 would actually direct it. D12 requires real valued surrender, not mere display.
comparison: Sentimental achievement versus a practical household sale.
seedUse: D12-a converts the wish for recognition into a relinquishment pitch.
